topic: ROUND THREE of this lane: five bounded iterations on angles the first two rounds covered thinly or not at all. Round one (GLM 5.3 Flash) and round two (DeepSeek V4 Flash) each ran ten iterations; their syntheses are lineages/glm-5-3-flash-templates/research.md and lineages/deepseek-v4-flash-templates/research.md; the census that judged every row of both rounds is research/confirmed-findings.md; every confirmed row was remediated in 010-template-contract-alignment and 016-template-seams-and-sentinel-repair. Read the census once in iteration 1, the earlier syntheses only if an angle sends there. || Role: Skeptical auditor — every claim unverified until cited. Read checked-in source only (dist/ is stale and untracked); code overrides self-reported success and overrides every document. Never write a script, harness, re-implementation or census program; read files and compare lines by hand, sample at most 8 items where a set is larger. Do not re-report a row the census marks fixed, kept or recorded unless new evidence shows its stated reason wrong; never reuse an earlier count — if a set cannot be recounted within the call budget, say so instead of guessing. || Action, one angle per iteration, in this order: (1) Scaffold versus validate for the three packet types (phase, review, research): create.sh's document-writing block vs check-files.sh and check-template-source.sh; a type whose scaffold would fail its own rule untouched is a finding. (2) Upgrade paths: upgrade-level.sh per-level blocks vs fresh scaffold at the target level (Level 2 and Level 3 rows of spec-kit-docs.json); a document or section a fresh scaffold has and the upgrade does not add is a finding. (3) Placeholders that survive a scaffold: check-placeholders.sh pattern block vs bracketed tokens shipped in at most 8 templates; a token shape the pattern would not detect is a finding. (4) Human-voice reference vs templates that cite it: hvr-rules.md vs every template carrying an HVR_REFERENCE comment (at most 8); a rule a template's own boilerplate breaks is a finding. (5) Overlap with sk-doc templates: sk-doc template directories carrying spec-kit document templates (spec.md / acceptance-criteria in names, at most 8) vs the system-spec-kit template of the same document; differing required sections or anchors, or an exact copy, is a finding. || Format: one row per finding: path:line on claim side and actual side; claimed vs actual in one sentence each; severity (P0 broken, P1 wrong/unused, P2 cosmetic); recommendation (remove/merge/fix/document); at most 12 rows per iteration; a short list of what the angle verified as correct; close each pass with open questions. || Target: a cited defect-and-simplification ledger organized by angle. Non-goals: no edits, no redesign, no prose-style review, no repository-wide census, no validate.sh, no node tooling, no git writes.
